about_the_game:
Purchase this DLC in order to host Rallyman GT games. Other players are not required to purchase it in otder to join.

1-6 Players | 45-60 Minutes

Recommended Age: 14+

In Rallyman: GT, you’ll take control of a race car, laying out gear dice to determine your speed and trajectory through the racing track. Players have a limited set of dice to find the most optimal way to progress through a specific sequence of actions, that might include accelerating, decelerating, and braking. But there’s a catch, the more dice you try to squeeze in your turn, the more likely to incur a loss of control!

Every turn is a balancing act between risk and reward:

  • Warning Symbols: Each die rolled has a chance of adding warning symbols. Roll too many in one turn, and you’ll spin out, losing precious time and distance—or even damaging your car.

  • Push Your Luck: Play cautiously by rolling one die at a time, or take a risk by rolling multiple dice for a quicker lead.

  • Dynamic Tracks: Modular hexagon tiles allow for a great number of circuits to race in, keeping the game fresh every time.

Whether navigating sharp corners or deciding whether to brake on a dangerous stretch, every decision counts. Choose your strategy carefully to leave your opponents in the dust and be the first to cross the finish.

Key Features:

  • Exciting Dice Mechanics: Place and roll gear dice to navigate the track, with every roll bringing tension and excitement.

  • Solo or Multiplayer: Play solo against the clock, or compete against up to five opponents.

  • Strategic Depth: Balance speed and caution to avoid spinning out while staying ahead of your rivals.

Will you race to victory, or spin out on the final turn? The track is yours to conquer!

short_description: Get behind the wheel and push your car—and your luck—to the limit in this high-speed racing game! Rallyman: GT is a roll-and-move game where you’ll navigate treacherous tracks, manage risks, and race to the finish line. Will you take the risk to speed ahead, or play it safe to stay in control?
